title: How Turning His Phone Gray Broke What Was Running Him
caption:
Red badges and bright icons aren't neutral. They're built by people paid to pull your eyes back before your brain agrees to it. It's not a lack of discipline. It's an engineered pull.

So stop fighting it with willpower alone. Settings, then Accessibility, then grayscale. Sixty seconds and the whole phone goes flat. Without the color, the pull weakens on its own.

Move the Bible app to your home screen, front row. Whoever you reach for first owns the day.

Give it one gray week. You'll notice how much of your day the phone was quietly running, and how much quieter the itch to check gets.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #digitaldetox
